args.sql: SELECT l.service_code,l.status,COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lease_finance.asset_order a WHERE a.is_delete=0 AND a.loan_code=l.loan_code)) AS with_asset,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lease_finance.payment_order p WHERE p.is_delete=0 AND p.loan_code=l.loan_code)) AS with_payment FROM lease_finance.loan_apply l WHERE l.id BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND l.is_delete=0 GROUP BY l.service_code,l.status LIMIT 20

SELECT a.asset_source,a.trans_model,COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lease_finance.payment_order p WHERE p.asset_order_no=a.asset_order_no AND p.is_delete=0)) AS with_payment FROM lease_finance.asset_order a WHERE a.id BETWEEN 3 AND 3531 AND a.is_delete=0 AND a.asset_source='1' GROUP BY a.asset_source,a.trans_model LIMIT 10

SELECT NOW() AS checked_at,'ol_purchase' AS scope,MIN(p.id) AS min_id,MAX(p.id) AS max_id,COUNT(*) AS eligible_count,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ol_order.payment_order pay WHERE pay.is_delete=0 AND pay.purchase_order_no=p.order_no AND COALESCE(pay.batch_no,'')='')) AS with_payment FROM ol_order.purchase_order p WHERE p.id BETWEEN 259 AND 4000 AND p.is_delete=0 AND p.order_status='accept' AND COALESCE(p.split_flag,0)=0 AND p.check_in_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT NOW(),'lease_rentsale_loan',MIN(l.id),MAX(l.id),COUNT(*),SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lease_finance.payment_order p WHERE p.is_delete=0 AND p.loan_code=l.loan_code)) FROM lease_finance.loan_apply l WHERE l.id BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND l.is_delete=0 AND l.service_code='RSSEV20250115' AND l.status='360' LIMIT 2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,MIN(id) AS min_id,MAX(id) AS max_id FROM ol_order.lease_apply_batch WHERE id>=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT l.status,l.service_status,COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ol_order.purchase_order p WHERE p.application_no=l.application_code AND p.is_delete=0 AND p.order_status='accept')) AS with_accepted_purchase,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ol_order.payment_order p WHERE p.application_no=l.application_code AND p.is_delete=0)) AS with_payment FROM ol_order.lease_apply l WHERE l.id BETWEEN 1 AND 5417 AND l.is_delete=0 AND l.acceptance_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.status,l.service_status LIMIT 30
